Preserve secure cookies, allowlist and server-side authorization; do not broaden grants or alter unrelated schedule configuration. On the exact candidate, the hosted test then passed initial sign-in, stale-MFA denial, and unchanged schedule. The runner now waits up to five minutes at that final challenge, matching the initial sign-in window.
